verdict.rationale: Productboard documents a first-party Webhooks API for subscribing to entity change events and receiving real-time notifications at a user-registered endpoint. Reference docs cover creating, listing, and deleting webhook subscriptions, which makes these registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for programmatic consumers. Missing for 10: documented event catalog/payload schemas, delivery guarantees (signing, retries), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: The Webhooks API allows you to subscribe to events in Productboard and receive real-time notifications when data changes.
Creates a new webhook subscription to be actively notified on each change in the specified entities.
Permanently deletes a webhook subscription. No further notifications will be sent after deletion.
